sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Genjutsu (Visual), Lightning Release, Sensory

system.description:
You touch a willing or incapacitated creature and begin combing through their memories searching for a specific event. The creature does not need to remember said event, they need to only have experienced it firsthand. An unconscious creature make an Intelligence saving throw.

Success: Affected creature only shares information within the past day. You extract the memory, as they forget all that occurred within the timeframe extracted for the next 24 hours. This extracted memory takes the form of a small sphere of data release that you can experience at will for the next 24 hours. For the duration, you and willing creatures within 15 feet of you can become immersed in the memory and experience it as if the were the creature experiencing it, first hand, but able to move about the experience on their own, able to pause, rewind or speed up events through the end point of the memory.

Failure: Same as success, but the affected creature shares information they’ve experienced within the past week.

Critical Failure: Same as success, but the affected creature shares information they’ve experienced within the past month.
